faqs: Q: My phone is not detected when I scan?
A: Make sure Developer Options are unlocked and 'USB debugging' is enabled on your phone. Re-plug the USB and check for an authorization prompt on your phone's screen.
Q: How do I connect wirelessly?
A: Connect over USB, choose Get IP, enable TCP/IP and select Connect Wi-Fi. Android 11 and later also support Pair with code.
Q: Why is there no audio playing?
A: Audio forwarding requires Android 11 or later. Check the mute switch in Advance settings. Camera streams run without audio.
Q: The stream is lagging or pixelated?
A: In Advance settings, try 4 Mbps or limit the maximum size to 1080 pixels to reduce bandwidth.
